## Meeting Purpose

[Align on project priorities, roles, and marketing strategy.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=2452.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - **Customer Acquisition is the \#1 Priority:** The team will shift focus from development to marketing to secure 2–4 new clients.
  - [**Roles Defined:** Adrian will lead marketing (lead magnets, outreach), Enes will lead development (bugs, features), and Luís will lead design/UX cleanup.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=2452.0)
  - [**Technical Foundation:** The repo will move to the Mindtreasure org to enable GitHub Actions for E2E tests, unblocking critical refactors like centralizing routes.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=4888.0)
  - [**Branding Refresh:** The current logo will be replaced with a new wordmark and icon, with Luís exploring options based on existing proposals.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=2539.0)

## Topics

### Marketing & Customer Acquisition

  - [**Urgency:** Customer acquisition is the top priority. The product is "pedal tested" (12k+ orders for Casais) and ready for market.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=629.0)
  - [**B2B Strategy:** The team will remain flexible on custom features for new clients, using feature flags for client-specific needs and incorporating universal improvements into the core product.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=897.0)
  - [**Lead Generation:**](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=1375.0)
      - [**Lead Magnets:** A "food waste calculator" and white paper will capture leads by providing free value.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=1375.0)
      - [**Content Marketing:** Blog posts will simplify complex regulations (e.g., EU food waste laws) to attract relevant traffic.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=1468.0)
      - [**GEO/SEO:** Focus on Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) to capture traffic from AI-powered search results.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=1012.0)
      - [**Product Hunt:** A launch will boost domain rating.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=1169.0)
      - [**Networking:** Adrian will attend the Intragast trade fair to meet prospects.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=1705.0)
  - [**Target Customers:**](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=1536.0)
      - [**Initial Focus:** Smaller canteens (200–500 meals/day) and universities, as large corporates are harder to reach.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=1815.0)
      - [**Key Influencers:** Chefs and canteen managers.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=1763.0)
      - [**High-Value Niche:** Offshore platforms (ships, oil rigs) due to their complex food logistics.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=1606.0)

### Roles & Responsibilities

  - [**Adrian:**](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=2458.0)
      - [**Focus:** 100% marketing.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=2458.0)
      - [**Tasks:** Lead magnet development, content creation, outreach, trade fair attendance.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=5051.0)
  - [**Enes:**](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=2458.0)
      - [**Focus:** 100% development.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=2458.0)
      - [**Tasks:** Bug fixes, feature development, PR reviews.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=2458.0)
  - [**Luís:**](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=3134.0)
      - [**Focus:** Design, UX cleanup, and project organization.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=3134.0)
      - [**Tasks:** UI/UX stories, quick-win tweaks, branding refresh, E2E test setup.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=3148.0)

### Technical Cleanup & E2E Testing

  - [**Project Organization:**](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=2104.0)
      - [**Shortcut:** Now the central source of truth for all stories and documentation.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=2212.0)
      - [**Notion:** Luís's free tier was blocked by admin access; the team will be set to "viewer" to resolve this.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=2104.0)
  - [**E2E Testing:**](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=3398.0)
      - [**Goal:** Implement E2E tests to enable safer refactors (e.g., centralizing routes).](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=3398.0)
      - [**Tooling:** Playwright for tests, SuperWrite for managing test data in Superbase.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=3487.0)
      - [**CI/CD:** Tests will run on GitHub Actions for PRs, with a label-triggered option for long-running suites.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=4531.0)
  - [**Backlog Audit:** A recent audit by Claude was incorrect. Enes will re-audit the backlog to correctly identify implemented vs. pending stories.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=3688.0)

### Branding & Logo

  - [**Problem:** The current logo is outdated and will be replaced.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=2539.0)
  - [**Decision:** Luís will explore two options:](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=2946.0)
    1.  [**Wordmark:** A simple, modern typographic logo.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=2964.0)
    2.  [**Icon + Wordmark:** Combine the "B with a byte" icon from the Modita proposals with a new wordmark.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=3039.0)

### Casais Client Update

  - [**Status:** Casais is actively using the app again (85 dinners, 81 lunches scanned since Jan 12).](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=1942.0)
  - [**Action:** Luís will contact Felipe to get an update on the internal presentation and offer support.](https://fathom.video/share/LyjGxRdsCJuSZdMy3VA38Lzcxj8ps5xL?tab=summary&timestamp=5549.0)
